page_title: NAN 0-2 BRE | Nantes v Brest 07/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+6' 0 - 2 GOAL! Superb work from Mama Balde, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest), who beats Anthony Lopes with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 0:2.
90+2' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Marco Bizot (Brest) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
86' Yellow card! It's like Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Jeremie Pignard agrees and books him.
85' The resulting corner from Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) is cleared.
84' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dehmaine Assoumani (Nantes) comes onto the pitch for Douglas Augusto.
82' Antoine Kombouare has decided to substitute Johann Lepenant and he is replaced by Florent Mollet (Nantes).
82' Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) got on the ball on the edge of the box and blazed a first-time shot well over the bar.
80' Here's the change. Hugo Magnetti leaves the pitch and Kamory Doumbia (Brest) comes on as a substitute.
79' Meschack Elia (Nantes) can't believe his eyes as he misses a big opportunity to convert a rebound. The ball brushes the left post.
78' It will be a corner kick for Nantes.
75' Shots on target – 2:2.
74' The ball rebounded to Massadio Haidara (Brest), whose first-time shot from long range had the keeper scrambling but flew just wide of the right post.
72' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Brest out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) is coming onto the pitch as Abdallah Sima cannot continue after picking up an injury.
70' Eric Roy prepares a substitution. Romain Faivre is replaced by Mama Balde (Brest).

69' What a chance that is! Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post.
69' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nantes comes to nothing.
69' Substitution. Marcus Coco makes his way off the pitch and Kelvin Amian (Nantes) comes on as his replacement.
69' Antoine Kombouare has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) replacing Mostafa Mohamed.
68' Substitution. Meschack Elia (Nantes) in, Moses Simon out.
67' A dangerous looking corner kick from Kenny Lala (Brest) is cleared to safety by the defence.
65' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jeremie Pignard had an easy-decision to make.
63' Moses Simon (Nantes) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
62' Saidou Sow (Nantes) is quickest inside the box and jumps to connect with the resulting set piece. He produces a fine header, but it flies just wide of the right post.
62' Moses Simon (Nantes) prepares to take a corner kick.
59' Mahdi Camara (Brest) darts into the box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He produces a poor shot which goes well over the crossbar.
57' 54:46 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
54' Moses Simon (Nantes) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
52' Moses Simon (Nantes) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

52' Moses Simon (Nantes) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball goes out for a corner. Nantes can continue in their attacking effort.
50' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) trips an opposition player and Jeremie Pignard signals a foul.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' Jeremie Pignard has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Romain Faivre (Brest) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

43' Marco Bizot doesn't have to worry about this one. Marcus Coco plays a pass into the feet of Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes high over the bar.
39' The resulting corner from Moses Simon (Nantes) is cleared by the defence.
38' Romain Faivre (Brest) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.
37' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Anthony Lopes.
37' Nantes have a goal-scoring opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
36' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
35' Romain Faivre (Brest) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
33' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Brest.
30' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 0:1.
27' Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle after Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
26' Moses Simon (Nantes) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
25' Matthis Abline (Nantes) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
23' Moses Simon (Nantes) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
22' Moses Simon (Nantes) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
20' The free kick finds Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) in space in the box, but he can't keep his header down and sends it just over the bar from close range.
18' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Massadio Haidara (Brest).
17' What a miss! The corner finds Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just wide of the right post.
17' Corner kick. Moses Simon (Nantes) is ready to send the ball into the box.
13' The Nantes players are exchanging some short passes.
10' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Brest players have a reason to celebrate!
10' The Brest players joy may have been justified, because referee Jeremie Pignard is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
9' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) has a goal ruled out for offside!
9' 0 - 1 Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) scores with a header. Despite the ball going into the middle of the goal, the goalkeeper was unable to pull off a save.
9' It seemed like Kenny Lala (Brest) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
7' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) switches the play to Brendan Chardonnet and their attacking move continues.
4' It seemed like Romain Faivre (Brest) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
3' Moses Simon (Nantes) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Nantes will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Jeremie Pignard.
